[quote=nordiheim;59310444]My first attempt at expansion RP/lore :|

[u][b]The expansion that led to discovery[/b][/u]
In the year 955 AD, after the Nordiheimians had solidified how they wanted there nation to be ruled and made it a propper nation instead of a loose alliance of people that shared a common history and origin, it whas decided to finaly start to explore and expand out into the center of Argos properly and find out if there were more out there then simply small comuneties and nomadic tribes of Aboriginals no larger then a few dozen induviduals.
Could they find land and resources to suport there growing nation?
Were there anyting around them that could be called someting similar to a country withinn there limited reach that perhaps could be traded with?

The new council of Nordiheim voted unanimously to send out two exploration and settler groups from each region that made up Nordiheim to cover almoust all directions, with one group from midland going north towards were there people had made landfall allmoust 2000 years ago to see if they could find any hint that the Eastlanders were still there or even alive.

The groups from Vestland went south-east and west, those that went east found noting but empty land while those that traveled southeast found a small tribe by lake Lifvatns shore, unfortunatly they had heard of no one but Nordiheim itself that resembled what the Westerners asked them about regarding a 'nation'.

The groups that left from Midland went north and west and had a little more luck, in the north they heard tales of a small town that had been made forther north that had people that shared some simularities with them, tough they were still a bit of a distance away, perhaps they were straglers of the exodus or even Easterners that tried to follow them after they had left for the center of Argos all those generations ago?
And the group the went to the west heard tales that there might be a large group of people living by the coast in the north-west.

But the greatest discovery whas made by the two groups from Sorland who went south-east and east, the group that went south-east along lakeshore of Lifvatn found a small tribe that told them that indeed there did exist someting like this 'nation' they asked about, out east there were the lands of the 'sand traders' who rode around on great beasts with two humps on there backs that could go for ages without drinking any water and had great spirits inside them, they also showed them some of the tings they had traded with them, a metal with a pinkish golden color that the southeners recogniced as a mix of gold and copper, this whas a big discovery, the nation of Nordiheim had always had problems geting there hands on enough copper and these traders seemed to have it, they sendt out a messengers to Sorlands regional capital Uragrad to inform them about these 'sand traders' and there potential copper and that the supporting caravan that whas ment to be sendt after them should be redirected to the east going group instead to increase the chance of them finding these traders.
The group going east had not found anyting in the direction they were traveling and whas about to give up when a messenger from Uragrad reached them and informed them about the 'sand traders' and there beasts and that they needed to put all there effort into finding them, more people and resources whas comming to them to suport them in this, this invigorated the group as they now had a renewed duty to do for there people and it would all start when there suport made the trek to them.

[u][b]Finding the sand traders[/b][/u]

When the people and resources finaly got to the east going Southlander group they found a group waiting somewhat impatiently for them, wanting to continue further east as soon as possible, after giving the new people a day to rest the now larger group sett out to go further east to hopefully find the mysterious sand traders and potentialy a source of copper with them.
They did not have the most fun journey trough the dessert as it seemd somehow even hotter our here far away from lake Lifvatn, and being on foot certainly did not help this, leading them to quickly deciding to travel after the sun had set and stop before it got to hot.
This continued for several days interupted only by the discovery of an oasis every now and then, someting that the travelers were thankfull for, but after about 4 weeks the leading people spotted someting as they came over a sand dune, cloaked people riding strange beasts that resembled the what they had been informed about, had they finaly found the 'sand traders'?

The 'sand traders' approached them in a peacefull manner, giving no sign of hostility or suden movements, seeming to be led by a person wearing a mask, he greeted the leaders of the group in a aboriginal dialect that they thankfully could understand tough they could tell it whas from far away and when they answered his greeting he seemed to understand them as well.
They told these 'sand traders' who they were and that they came from Nordiheim and asked to know who they were in return, the mysterius masked man said that they were the people of Alkiragunya and that they were humble traders that would gladly trade with them in peace if they themself allowed it.
They asked the masked man about copper and the strange beast they rode around on and if these were things they were willing to trade with Nordiheim, the answer that whas given whas yes, he told them that the beasts were called camels and that within them resided the great spirits who made the world during the Dreamtime making them holy beings and they would trade them to Nordiheim for the right price and a prommis that they would be handled with respect.
While some of the southlanders did not like this idea about the Dreamtime, as it did not go along with there religion, they had been stritcly told in the message from Uragrad to ignore any potential heresy for the sake of gaining access to copper (and anyting ells the traders might be able to offer them), conversion could come at a later date when they understod them bether.
(This religius conversion would thankfully never happen, as the midlanders and westerners would make sure of it, as they found this Dreamtime myth to be harmless and did not want to risk the trade over it)

This first meeting would end in a promis of future talks and trade as the masked trader said he would come to Nordiheim himself, aswell as a gift of camels from the Alkiragunya traders as a sign of peace and a creation of friendship, these camels would make the trek home a dream compared to there travel out here for the southlanders and make these camels someting that Nordiheim would value almoust as highly as copper to gain from Alkirangunya.[/quote]
The trader loves to help;p

[quote=sal-baliz;59285226][spoiler=[b]The Great Jihad - Part 3[/b]
[i]In the shadows of despair, our blind devotion to faith transforms fear into a reckless courage that leads us to destruction[/i]]
Sand churns up from the ground underneath the armoured vehicles as they speed towards the holy city. A renewed urge to fight has been instilled in the soldiers, almost as if the very presence of Mecca is affected them. The soldiers are no longer afraid of the Hydronians and their allies, they have a sense of hatred towards them. No longer will they hide and cower whenever a helicopter passes by, they will stand up and shout and cheer, firing their machine guns into the sky.
"Down with Hydronia!" they shout, "Down with Hydronia!"

12 hours had passed since the unit set off when they arrived at a large hill made of sand. Abd ordered them to begin setting up camp there. The soldiers jumped out of their vehicles and began setting up various pieces of military equipment as instructed. One soldier was curious enough to peek over the edge of the hill and what he saw was unexpected. Around 2km from the hill lay a sprawling urban area, Mecca. This in itself was not unexpected and was in fact a sight to behold for the soldier, but what encircled it was not. A huge perimeter of soldiers, Hydronian, bobian and indonocaismnican. Luckily he went unnoticed by the army that lay before him, but the realisation set in that he would have to face them soon.After all of the equipment had been set up, Abd stood atop the hill, just low enough so he wouldn't be spotted by the snipers below.

"Listen up, Listen up! Today is a great day for our people, but not just our people, for all muslims of Erene! Today is the day that Mecca finally returns to the hands of those who rightfully deserve it, those who follow Allah's every wish and those who dedicate their lives to the greatness of Islam! We may be outnumbered, we may be outskilled, but we are not outplayed in our devotion and faith! We live to serve Allah and he will give us power! Follow me my brothers and let Allah lead us to victory! Long live Islam! Long live the Jihad! Allahu Akbar!"

As he spoke the final words of his speech, he climbed to the top of the hill and raised his gun high, signalling for the others to follow. They chanted Abd's words in perfect unison as they charged down the hill, ready to face whatever lay below...

Sir I see something! I think its the Sal-Baliz! Shouts a young private over the din. Suddenly everything goes quiet.
Can we have confirmation on that General Eden says down a radio. A few seconds, then a response.
Confirmed, a unit of around 1,000
That isnt many? He thought to himself, before calling for everyone to get ready. An army of soldiers from the BR. Bob, Indonocaismnic and Hydronia all assemble into formation. The first gunshots echoed through the desert and into the holy city. The sound of panic resonates out of the city walls.
Fire! Eren calls and in an instant the first 10 soldiers have been mowed down by machine gun fire. The machine guns continued to fire, but the coalition forces also suffered. Soon soldiers on both sides were dropping like flies. 

As the battle continued to escalate, Eren gave the order to use missiles and tanks. Small rockets zoomed through the air towards the hill, scattering sand everywhere. Tanks rolled forward, but were ineffective to the enemy grenades. Despite this, the Sal-Baliz were greatly outnumbered and the battle was making progress. That is until a few hours in. The Sal-Baliz had suffered heavy casualties and were forced to hold their position behind the hill. The coalition was slowly gaining ground, but suddenly a sound was heard in the distance, from behind the city. A Bobian soldier spotted something in the distance,
A ship! He cried out, A ship!
Hoards of pirates armed with everything from knives to rocket launchers had landed and were making their way towards the city. It appeared the Sal-Baliz had hired criminals in order to assist the war effort. Confusion followed as the army was split in two to fight the enemy from both sides. Amidst this confusion yet another unexpected twist took place. Rumbling came from above and with it a team of 100 paratroopers. The [nation]extreme Islam rebels of asyla[/nation] that had fled to Sal-Baliz have been put to work. The army descended into chaos as attacks came from all fronts
